notes: The prompt calls itself a game but describes only a colour, a mood and some houses, and the clarifying question about whether there is anything to do came back as no goal, no loop and no multiplayer - it never landed on a genre, so this is No Genre and its Explorable Place preset, which is exactly the small place-to-wander case. No shape row applies; every axis stays at its default, so it routes P0 as one single-surface exterior. The preset's landmark-focal, path-circulation and vignette-photo carry a hero build to orient on, lanes to stroll, and composed spots to look at the pink sunset from, and I added settlement-density for the cute pink houses so they read as a small cluster of cottages rather than scattered props. Nobody asked to go inside them, so building-interior and its P3 stay off; I decided the pink sunset is lighting and palette for the image pass rather than a layout feature.
